card.name: Prepositions before Earth, planet or star
card.fires_on: Small linking words (from, to, through, onto, of, toward, with) in physics and astronomy text, right before a large natural body or physical thing such as the Earth, the Moon, a planet, a star or a field.

modes.label: Motion from or through a body
modes.description: A preposition after a verb of movement or radiation, before the Earth or a planet.
modes.example: it absorbs a large portion of the infrared radiation coming<< from>> the Earth.

modes.label: Attraction or alignment
modes.description: A preposition after a verb of pulling or aligning, before a planet or a field direction.
modes.example: so they're attracted<< to>> the planet by gravity.

modes.label: Position relative to a celestial body
modes.description: A preposition of location or direction before the Moon, a star or the ground.
modes.example: put boots on the surface<< of>> the Moon,” NASA told us.

card.writes: It pushes the next word away from science nouns like genome, atom, spectrum, nucleus and atmosphere.
card.plain: It fires on little words like from, to or through when the next word is likely to be the Earth, a planet or a star.
